text.p: Bonds were gaining in low volatility in line with the European trend but little action was expected until after the U.S. inflation figures are released at 1230 GMT, dealers said.

Despite the slightly easier one year treasury bill yield at auction on Wednesday, yields at the short to medium end of the curve were not seen falling from current levels, so the curve would not steepen, they added.
They said the 15 basis point spread with the Spanish three year Bono was reasonable and therefore the Portuguese yield was unlikely to ease unilaterally.
"Things are going to mark time until the U.S. (figures are released)," said one trader.
